name: Paul Skokowski
abstract: Providing a physical explanation of qualia comprises the “hard problem” of consciousness. Here we consider the qualia delivered through sensation by establishing the thesis of sensory naturalism, which recognizes our senses as detectors of physical properties in the world. Sensory naturalism challenges the widespread assumption in the biological and physical sciences that qualia can be understood solely by studying the brain and its internal mechanisms.
